name: Estimated Fund Cash Forecast 5
definition: Cash movements from or to a fund as a result of investment funds transactions, eg, subscriptions or redemptions.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Unique technical identifier for an instance of a fund cash forecast within a fund cash forecast report as assigned by the issuer of the report.

TradeDateTime.name: Trade Date Time
TradeDateTime.definition: Date and, if required, the time, at which the price will be applied.

PreviousTradeDateTime.name: Previous Trade Date Time
PreviousTradeDateTime.definition: Previous date and time at which the price was applied.

FinancialInstrumentDetails.name: Financial Instrument Details
FinancialInstrumentDetails.definition: Investment fund class to which the cash flow is related.

EstimatedTotalNAV.name: Estimated Total NAV
EstimatedTotalNAV.definition: Estimated total value of all the holdings, less the fund's liabilities, attributable to a specific investment fund class.

PreviousTotalNAV.name: Previous Total NAV
PreviousTotalNAV.definition: Previous value of all the holdings, less the fund's liabilities, attributable to a specific investment fund class.

EstimatedTotalUnitsNumber.name: Estimated Total Units Number
EstimatedTotalUnitsNumber.definition: Estimated total number of investment fund class units that have been issued.

PreviousTotalUnitsNumber.name: Previous Total Units Number
PreviousTotalUnitsNumber.definition: Previous value of all the holdings, less the fund's liabilities, attributable to a specific investment fund class.

EstimatedTotalNAVChangeRate.name: Estimated Total NAV Change Rate
EstimatedTotalNAVChangeRate.definition: Rate of change of the net asset value.

InvestmentCurrency.name: Investment Currency
InvestmentCurrency.definition: Currency of the investment fund class.

CurrencyStatus.name: Currency Status
CurrencyStatus.definition: Information about the designation of the share class currency, that is, whether it is for onshore or offshore purposes and other information that may be required. This is typically only required for CNY funds.

ExceptionalNetCashFlowIndicator.name: Exceptional Net Cash Flow Indicator
ExceptionalNetCashFlowIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the estimated net cash flow is exceptional.

Price.name: Price
Price.definition: Price per unit of the previous trade date.

EstimatedPercentageOfShareClassTotalNAV.name: Estimated Percentage Of Share Class Total NAV
EstimatedPercentageOfShareClassTotalNAV.definition: Estimated net cash flow expressed as a percentage of the previous total NAV for the share class.

BreakdownByUserDefinedParameter.name: Breakdown By User Defined Parameter
BreakdownByUserDefinedParameter.definition: Estimated cash flow by a user defined parameter/s.

EstimatedNetCashForecastDetails.name: Estimated Net Cash Forecast Details
EstimatedNetCashForecastDetails.definition: Estimated net cash movements per financial instrument.

ExceptionalCashFlowIndicatorRule.definition: If ExceptionalNetCashFlowIndicator is "true" or "1" (Yes), then at least one or more of the following must be present:|BreakdownByParty/CashInForecast/ExceptionalCashFlowIndicator, or|BreakdownByParty/CashOutForecast/ExceptionalCashFlowIndicator, or|BreakdownByCountry/CashInForecast/ExceptionalCashFlowIndicator, or|BreakdownByCountry/CashOutForecast/ExceptionalCashFlowIndicator, or|BreakdownByCurrency/CashInForecast/ExceptionalCashFlowIndicator, or|BreakdownByCurrency/CashOutForecast/ExceptionalCashFlowIndicator, or|BreakdownByUserDefinedParameter/CashInForecast/ExceptionalCashFlowIndicator, or|BreakdownByUserDefinedParameter/CashOutForecast/ExceptionalCashFlowIndicator.
